protocol.cold: first vize check process per side/mode/corpus; filesystem caches are not evicted
protocol.steady: fresh CLI and native TypeScript processes; filesystem caches may be warm; no persistent checker session
protocol.rotation: base/head then head/base, alternating within each row
protocol.gates: all minimal plants and full timed corpus plus plant, on every side and thread mode before warmups
protocol.profile: separate --profile-json runs after all unprofiled timing pairs, excluded from timings
